name: aqua-orb-underwater
prompt: Tall portrait view from beneath the sea, the lens tilted gently upward through water so clear and turquoise it looks freshly rendered. Far above, the surface is a wobbling silver-white sheet, and shafts of sunlight fall through it in long diagonal bands that fade as they reach the sandy floor. Hanging dead centre, a perfect clear glass sphere the size of a beach ball drifts weightless: a sharp crescent of white light glints along its upper rim, a softer cyan glow curls round its lower edge, and the bright water seen through it bends and swells as if through a lens. Where the sunbeams pass through the sphere they scatter into a little net of dancing light ripples on the sand below. Three chubby orange goldfish with flowing tails nose past one side of the sphere, a pair of yellow-and-black banded reef fish cut across the other, and from a pale coral at the bottom of the frame a slender stream of silver bubbles wobbles up past the glass toward the light. Everything is glossy, clean and slightly too perfect, like a desktop aquarium on an early-2000s computer left running in a bright office: saturated aqua, cyan and pure white with warm orange accents, crisp high-definition detail, soft bloom on the highlights, no murk, no debris, no people, no text or lettering anywhere. Thanks.
